names: period columns are read in time order, and a column's stated duration is read (TeamNostra fix request 2, RA-D5, V1-O2): a Financials header's period columns come in time order within each fiscal calendar, the calendars by their latest end (`ciq_sheets.period_columns`), so growth, the estimate base and a trajectory no longer follow the sheet's column order; the Estimates current and forward years and the next quarters are read by the year and quarter each label states, and the listing's 'Current' column by its header; a '6 months' or '9 months' column is a year-to-date period ('6M-26'), never a quarter, and no QoQ, YoY or growth spans it. On the 36 export folders on disk no read moves
